metadata.defaultTitle: Kenet: a personal journal built on people, places and time
metadata.defaultDescription: Kenet is a personal journal that needs no account and keeps everything in plain Markdown files. It links the short entries you write during the day to people, places and time on its own, in a vault Obsidian can open.
